General FAQs

Get answers to the most common questions about Tenth Rock, our services, and how we operate across the nation.

Tenth Rock Solutions is a nationwide commercial waste management company that provides centralized waste services across all 50 states. We simplify waste management for multi-location businesses through a single point of contact, consolidated billing, and transparent performance tracking.

We provide waste management services across all 50 states. Our extensive network of vetted hauler partners ensures consistent, reliable coverage whether your locations are in major metropolitan areas or rural communities.

For emergency requests, we can often be on-site within hours. For standard scheduled services, we can typically start within 24-48 hours of account setup. Our rapid response capability is one of our core differentiators.

We handle almost all non-hazardous commercial waste streams including general trash, recycling (cardboard, plastic, metal), construction debris, organic waste, and e-waste. We also coordinate specialized hazmat disposal upon request through certified partners.

Getting started is simple. Request a service through our website or call us directly. We'll conduct an assessment of your needs, provide a customized proposal, and can typically have service running within days of agreement.
